truthAudit.Summary: Run 1 identified 15 of the 20 true vulnerabilities at title/evidence level, but most were partial because severity or CWE did not match the ground truth. It missed five true vulnerabilities: SC-V3-012, SC-V3-014, SC-V3-015, SC-V3-016, and SC-V3-019. It also contained extra findings that are not true vulnerabilities, such as admin-exec command injection as a separate finding, a separate MemoryPool cleanup race, an input admin substr crash, unbounded variable store growth, and several overclaims or misclassifications.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Format string vulnerability in debug logging
Items.Notes: Run 1 contained the runtime format-string issue and the printf(active_format.c_str(), user_input) pattern at CWE-134, but assigned High severity instead of the true Critical severity.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Integer overflow and long runtime in factorial function
Items.Notes: Run 1 found factorial integer overflow at CWE-190 and quoted the result *= i loop, but assigned Low severity instead of the true High severity.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Use-after-free in deferred history flush during cleanup
Items.Notes: Run 1 found the deferred history flush use-after-free involving scratch, sleep_for, stage_deferred_history_flush, and memory::g_memory_pool.cleanup, but assigned High severity instead of the true Critical severity.
Run 1 found the validator_cmd and config_file concatenation into system(command.c_str()), but assigned High severity instead of the true Critical severity.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Stack buffer overflow due to inverted length check in evaluate_expression
Items.Notes: Run 1 found the evaluate_expression stack buffer overflow and also identified the related safe_string_copy dest[src_len] issue, but the main finding overclaimed Critical severity instead of the true High severity.
Run 1 found the ThreadSafeCounter race involving volatile long long and reading value_ before acquiring the mutex, but assigned Low severity instead of the true Medium severity.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Authentication bypass via emergency override backdoor
Items.Notes: Run 1 found the login_attempts_ > 5, EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE, authenticated_ = true logic bomb, but classified it as CWE-287 and overclaimed Critical severity instead of the true High CWE-511 logic bomb.

Run 1 found the config_dir_ + filename traversal issue at CWE-22 with Medium severity, but overclaimed absolute-path loading and direct exposure of arbitrary file contents beyond what the supplied concatenation-and-parsing code supports.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Heap buffer overflow in ExpressionParser::parse expression buffer
Items.Notes: Run 1 found the ExpressionParser heap overflow involving buffer_size_ = 256, allocation from g_memory_pool, and strcpy(expression_buffer_, expr_str.c_str()), and assigned the true Critical severity.

Run 1 found ADMIN_SECRET and SC_ENT_2025_AUTH as a hardcoded credential at CWE-798, but overclaimed Critical severity instead of the true High severity and also mentioned log exposure beyond the provided source.

Run 1 found weak session token generation using std::mt19937 and uniform_int_distribution over 1000 to 9999, but classified it as CWE-330 and Medium instead of the true CWE-338 High weak PRNG finding.
Run 1 did not contain any finding about the thread-unsafe static std::tm cached_time, localtime, or cached_time = *local_time timestamp cache in logging.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Command injection through audit event using environment path
Items.Notes: Run 1 found the environment-derived temporary audit path and system(command.c_str()) issue, but framed it as CWE-78 command injection instead of the true CWE-377 insecure temporary file handling vulnerability.
Run 1 did not contain a finding about persistent authentication state involving authenticated_, login_attempts_, or session_token_ as a distinct CWE-613 issue.
Run 1 did not contain a finding about the unhandled exception path in handle_variable_command involving std::stod(tokens[3]).

Run 1 did not contain a finding about integer underflow in MemoryPool::allocate block splitting involving SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES, previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES, and fragment.size = remaining.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Unbounded recursive descent can exhaust stack
Items.Notes: Run 1 found unbounded recursion in parse_factor/parse_expression with PAREN_OPEN and the missing MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH enforcement, but assigned Medium severity instead of the true High severity.
Run 1 found the result_cache_ data race in evaluate_cached where cache_mutex_ is not acquired, but overclaimed High severity instead of the true Medium severity.
Run 1 did not identify the TOCTOU issue involving std::filesystem::exists, sleep_for, and std::ifstream file in ConfigLoader::load_config.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Integer division by zero in calculate_route_score
Items.Notes: Run 1 found the calculate_route_score division by zero involving token_length and 100 / static_cast<int>(token_length), but overclaimed Medium severity instead of the true Low severity.
